incoming_refresh_role: local UAS regardless of initial call direction
outgoing_refresh_role: local UAC regardless of initial call direction
successful_update: apply interval/refresher/receipt time even without SDP; absent header disables timer
transaction_matching: latest locally generated UPDATE CSeq; consume once, unaffected by INFO
compact_header: Session-Expires and x/X accepted for received requests and UPDATE responses
request_refresher: case-insensitive uas/uac; existing default/response echo preserved
malformed_response: ignored without changing existing timer state
